title: Excavations in Palestine, 1943-6: The Citadel, Jerusalem
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Courtyard of the Citadel, Jerusalem ('Corner' tower); placed by name.
notes: Autumn 1946 soundings at the 'Corner' tower: tower tentatively early 1st c. BC; older back wall presumably Maccabean. Fortifications only; no eligible feature.
